analize-de-laborator.name: Laboratory Tests
analize-de-laborator.excerpt: Blood tests analyse the function of the body's organs, the immune system and the presence or activity of disease. Some tests can be used to stimulate or suppress…
analize-de-laborator.body:
Blood tests analyse the function of the body's organs, the immune system and the presence or activity of disease. Some tests can be used to stimulate or suppress an organ in order to assess its function more precisely. Newer tests can even analyse your pet's genetics for certain diseases or infections. If your furry friend needs special tests, we can send samples to Germany on request for specialist investigations.

Common tests assess liver, kidney and pancreatic function. Enzymes that indicate potential muscle damage and inflammation can also be tested. Red and white blood cells are tested as well, revealing your pet's hydration status, anaemia, inflammation or infection, and immune system responses.

Your pet's age and condition are usually enough to determine whether a blood test is needed. Blood tests are recommended before anaesthesia, especially if a problem is suspected. Because pets age much faster than people (almost seven years for each one of ours), an annual screening for any developing conditions is highly recommended.

radiografie.name: X-Ray
radiografie.excerpt: A radiograph, commonly called an X-ray, is a two-dimensional black-and-white image of a part of the inside of a body. An image is generated by passing…
radiografie.body:
A radiograph, commonly called an X-ray, is a two-dimensional black-and-white image
of a part of the inside of a body. An image is generated by passing radiation through a particular structure or area, such as the chest or a limb, and the image is then captured.

The images taken with our machine are digital, and radiography is
the most common and readily available imaging test in veterinary practice. It is used to assess the size and shape of organs such as the heart and lungs, as well as to reveal broken bones, some foreign bodies, fluid build-ups and many other abnormalities that can help with diagnosis.

It is also the most affordable imaging test and is
most often carried out before any of the other imaging options (ultrasound, MRI, CT).

ecografie.name: Ultrasound
ecografie.excerpt: Ultrasound can take different forms depending on the images produced. In veterinary medicine, B-mode (brightness mode) ultrasound, more commonly called…
ecografie.body:
Ultrasound can take different forms depending on the images produced. In veterinary
medicine, B-mode (brightness mode) ultrasound, more commonly called
two-dimensional ultrasound, is the most common form. It provides a
two-dimensional image of the organ being scanned. This is the type of ultrasound used to examine abdominal structures, diagnose pregnancy, assess heart function and examine the eyes for certain eye diseases.

M-mode (motion mode) is a type of B-mode in which a trace of the
movement of the scanned structure is displayed. A combination of M-mode and two-dimensional ultrasound is
used to examine the walls, chambers and valves of the heart in order to assess cardiac function. Cardiac ultrasound is usually referred to as echocardiography.

Doppler ultrasound is a specialised form of cardiac ultrasound that can measure the direction and speed of blood flow in the heart and blood vessels. Colour-flow Doppler technology makes it even easier to see blood flowing through the heart and the major blood vessels.

Anaesthesia is not usually needed for most ultrasound examinations,
unless biopsies are being taken. The technique is completely painless, and
most dogs will lie comfortably while the scan is performed.

Occasionally, if a dog is very frightened or restless, a sedative may be needed. If biopsies are to be taken, a short-acting anaesthetic or deep sedation will be needed to relax your pet during the procedure and to prevent potential complications.

medicina-interna.name: Internal Medicine
medicina-interna.excerpt: Internal medicine vets are the detectives who work to reach a diagnosis. Once we understand your pet's illness, we can discuss the options and…
medicina-interna.body:
Internal medicine vets are the detectives who work to reach a diagnosis. Once
we understand your pet's illness, we can discuss the options and tailor a treatment plan to your pet's individual needs.

Usually, after an initial consultation, a patient will be admitted for further
investigations, such as blood tests, X-rays, ultrasound or other complementary
examinations. After the tests, unless further treatment is needed
straight away, pets can go home to wait for the results.

Sometimes, if a patient is found to have a non-medical condition and, for example, needs surgery or cancer treatment, they can be treated at our clinic or transferred to a referral hospital.

Our team of vets is happy to discuss cases over the phone with fellow
vets, and to talk with you in an online session through our
“VIDEO VET” service before a formal consultation.

anestezie-inhalatorie-si-analgezie.name: Inhalation Anaesthesia and Analgesia
anestezie-inhalatorie-si-analgezie.excerpt: The role of our veterinary anaesthesia and analgesia service is to provide individualised perioperative and postoperative care for every animal. This involves…
anestezie-inhalatorie-si-analgezie.body:
The role of our veterinary anaesthesia and analgesia service is to provide individualised perioperative and postoperative care for every animal. This involves close liaison with other services, risk assessment, stabilisation, appropriate drug selection and careful monitoring during anaesthesia and recovery.

We are also involved in providing ongoing fluid therapy and pain management throughout a pet's stay in hospital.

This approach makes anaesthesia and surgery as safe and
as free from anxiety and pain as possible.

We use a wide range of medicines and different analgesic techniques, such as epidural analgesia and local and regional anaesthetic blocks, to provide optimal
pain relief for your pet.

We use an extensive range of anaesthetic monitoring equipment, tailored to each
patient. This includes: electrocardiography / pulse oximetry / capnography / inspired
gas monitoring / body temperature / invasive and non-invasive blood
pressure monitoring

terapie-intensiva.name: Intensive Care
terapie-intensiva.excerpt: When our patients are not well enough to be discharged, they are admitted to intensive care for continuous observation, treatment and…
terapie-intensiva.body:
When our patients are not well enough to be discharged, they are admitted to intensive care for continuous observation, treatment and round-the-clock care.

Many patients will also stay in the ICU for post-operative recovery if the surgery was complex, or when we are treating a pet considered at high risk of complications after surgery (for example, those with serious illnesses, older pets or very young ones).

Sometimes a chronic or terminal condition that has been manageable with outpatient treatment and home care can get worse. Some illnesses, such as cancer, can become more debilitating over time and therefore require hospitalisation. The intensive care unit is a specialised unit for animals, equipped with life-support technology and equipment. Because pets in an ICU are extremely ill or recovering from trauma or surgery, it is vital that they are kept away from other animals in an environment that is as sterile, quiet and temperature-controlled as possible.

Intensive monitoring and therapy include: blood pressure and blood
flow monitoring / IV fluid therapy / supportive medication / assisted ventilation / catheterisation / nutritional
support / pain control, and more.

consultatii-la-domiciliu.name: Home Visits
consultatii-la-domiciliu.excerpt: We know that sometimes it is simply not possible for you or your pet to come to our clinic for care. At such times…
consultatii-la-domiciliu.body:
We know that sometimes it is simply not possible for you or your pet
to come to our clinic for care. At such times, our veterinary team will offer home visits when needed.

In general, we recommend visiting a fully equipped and staffed practice near you if your pet is unwell. However, we understand there are occasions when this may not be possible.

To make life less stressful for everyone, we offer home visits
to make sure your pet receives exceptional care, whatever the circumstances.

If, after discussing the options with the vet, it is decided that a home visit is needed, we will schedule the best time for our team to visit your furry friend at your home.

chirurgie-tesuturi-moi.name: Soft Tissue Surgery
chirurgie-tesuturi-moi.excerpt: Soft tissue surgery is a varied branch of veterinary medicine and includes most surgical procedures that do not fall within the scope of…
chirurgie-tesuturi-moi.body:
Soft tissue surgery is a varied branch of veterinary medicine and includes
most surgical procedures that do not fall within the scope of orthopaedic surgery.

Areas covered include ear, nose and throat surgery,
as well as cardiothoracic, liver, gastrointestinal, urogenital, reconstructive skin and oncological surgery.

servicii-ortopedie.name: Orthopaedics
servicii-ortopedie.excerpt: Veterinary orthopaedic surgery deals with the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting a pet's musculoskeletal system –…
servicii-ortopedie.body:
Veterinary orthopaedic surgery deals with the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting a pet's musculoskeletal system – including bones,
joints, ligaments, muscles and tendons. It addresses diseases and abnormalities such as hip dysplasia, elbow joint disease, patellar luxation, orthopaedic diseases, trauma, injuries and other congenital or acquired conditions.

dermatologie.name: Dermatology
dermatologie.excerpt: Because most skin conditions are chronic in nature, re-examinations are common. These are usually carried out as outpatient procedures, so your pet…
dermatologie.body:
Because most skin conditions are chronic in nature, re-examinations are
common. These are usually carried out as outpatient procedures, so your
pet may stay at the hospital for a day, have the procedure and go
home later that day. Such specific investigations may include:
ear flushing, including video otoscopy / myringotomy to investigate middle
ear disease, including sampling / skin sampling for cytology to look for bacteria or fungi / skin sampling for culture of organisms / elimination diet trials for possible food allergies / skin biopsy sampling for analysis by a pathologist / blood tests to assess general health

The conditions we diagnose and manage include:
allergies affecting the skin, including allergic reactions to external parasites and food, and reactions to environmental pollen and moulds / identifying the causes of hair loss / external
parasites / unusual skin infections: mycobacterial, fungal and viral skin diseases / ear infections / skin cancers / autoimmune skin diseases / cutaneous drug reactions / inherited skin diseases, and more.

Your initial consultation will last about 30 minutes and
you will stay with your furry friend the whole time. During the consultation, we will
take the time to listen to your concerns and make notes on what you have
noticed in your furry friend.

We know that many owners struggle with their pet's skin problems,
either because they have not sought a vet's opinion or because the
vet has not been able to find a long-term solution for their furry
friend. Our team is trained to recognise certain signs
specific to skin diseases and to help improve your friend's quality of
life.

nutritie.name: Nutrition
nutritie.excerpt: Proper nutrition is essential when it comes to treating and managing various health problems. Sometimes it can even prevent pets from…
nutritie.body:
Proper nutrition is essential when it comes to treating and managing various health problems. Sometimes it can even prevent pets from developing common diseases. These include conditions such as diabetes, heart disease and high blood pressure. Such health conditions can shorten your pet's lifespan.

Healthy eating will also help prevent your furry friend
from becoming overweight or obese. This is a common contributor to a wide
range of health complications in pets. Understanding pet
nutrition is not as difficult as many pet owners think. With the help of pet nutrition counselling, your beloved furry friend will get the healthy, balanced diet they need to live a healthy, happy and long life alongside their human friends.

The different kinds of food that pets eat contain
different elements. Some of these elements are nutritious, meaning they contain
all the healthy goodness pets need. As a
pet owner, you should understand that some foods have no
nutritional value. That is why it is important to seek pet nutrition
advice and learn how to choose the right food.

oftamologie.name: Ophthalmology
oftamologie.excerpt: Eye examinations are performed using slit-lamp biomicroscopy, indirect ophthalmoscopy and tonometry. Other diagnostic tests during the examination include the Schirmer…
oftamologie.body:
Eye examinations are performed using slit-lamp
biomicroscopy, indirect ophthalmoscopy and tonometry. Other diagnostic tests during the examination
include the Schirmer tear test and fluorescein staining. Most
eye diseases are treated with medical therapy. However, some
eye problems require additional diagnostic and/or
surgical procedures.

We will explain all the treatment options in detail, including any costs that may be
involved, and answer any questions you have.

neurologie.name: Neurology
neurologie.excerpt: Before the neurological examination, the vet will gather information about the history of your friend's problem, reviewing the findings of other fellow vets…
neurologie.body:
Before the neurological examination, the vet will gather information about the history of your friend's problem, reviewing the findings of other fellow vets (where applicable) and the information you provide.

Neurological diseases tend to have a species, age, breed and occasionally sex predilection. These details, together with information about the onset, course and duration of the first symptom, not only help to describe the type of condition and the possible causes of the problem, but also help to confirm that the problem really is a neurological disorder.

The diagnostic process may include a combination of blood tests, diagnostic imaging (MRI or CT, myelography), cerebrospinal fluid sampling, advanced electrodiagnostics (electromyography, nerve conduction velocities) and nerve or muscle biopsy. After a diagnosis, the specialist will discuss the therapy options with you, which may include medication and/or surgical management.

Neurological disease can involve the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nervous system or muscles. Recovery depends on the disease and the location of the problem.

As always, we will be by your side, helping you manage your pet's condition and finding the best course of action for every situation.

detartraj.name: Dental Scaling
detartraj.excerpt: Dental health is a very important part of your pet's overall wellbeing. Your pet's teeth should be examined by a vet at least…
detartraj.body:
Dental health is a very important part of your pet's overall wellbeing. Your pet's teeth should be examined by a vet at least once a year for early signs of dental problems or disease.

Most dental disease occurs below the gum line, where it cannot be seen. That is why we recommend a thorough cleaning at least once a year. A dental cleaning includes scaling (to remove plaque and tartar) and polishing, similar to the process used on your own teeth during routine dental cleanings.

When you go to the dentist, you know the dentist is there to help. Your dentist can give you a local anaesthetic to minimise pain and discomfort. Your pet does not understand the benefits of a dental procedure and will move or bite to try to protect themselves.

Inhalation anaesthesia, among other methods, allows us to carry out the dental procedure with less stress and pain for your pet. It also allows for better cleaning and assessment of dental disease below the gum line. This is why, worldwide, it is recommended that dental procedures in small animals are performed under general anaesthesia.

Also, if there are complications affecting the tooth roots, we take X-rays when further assessment is needed.

vaccinare.name: Vaccination
vaccinare.excerpt: Our clinic offers routine vaccinations as part of our standard service, and we recommend that cats, dogs and rabbits are protected against these diseases through…
vaccinare.body:
Our clinic offers routine vaccinations as part of our standard service, and we recommend that cats, dogs and rabbits are protected against these diseases through annual vaccination.

A vaccination appointment is much more than just a quick injection. Our vets and veterinary nurses will carry out a full health check of your pet
to make sure nothing is wrong, and they will also make sure to listen to any worries or concerns you have, because we know how much it matters to you.

deparazitare-interna.name: Internal Parasite Treatment
deparazitare-interna.excerpt: Dogs and cats roam everywhere and anywhere. They love to play, and their play often involves their mouths. Playing with almost anything in their path, they may at some…
deparazitare-interna.body:
Dogs and cats roam everywhere and anywhere. They love to play, and their play often involves their mouths.

Playing with almost anything in their path, they may at some point pick up an internal parasite. Symptoms can include weight loss, breathing difficulties, licking and/or chewing the area under the tail, coughing, or even vomiting and diarrhoea.

At our clinic, we can test for, treat and prevent worms in your four-legged friend.

deparazitare-externa.name: External Parasite Treatment
deparazitare-externa.excerpt: Fleas and ticks can be much more than itchy pests. Both fleas and ticks feed on the blood of dogs and cats.…
deparazitare-externa.body:
Fleas and ticks can be much more than itchy pests. Both fleas and ticks feed on the blood of dogs and cats. This can cause allergic reactions and spread disease, and our pets can be intermediate hosts for some parasites that even affect humans. Fleas can live for up to 12 months and produce millions of offspring.

Ticks carry diseases such as Lyme disease and anaplasmosis. The best defence against fleas and ticks is good-quality external parasite treatment.

Medicines that prevent fleas, ticks and mange mites come in several forms. We have spot-on solutions, tablets and collars. Preventive medication is safe for your pet and fights fleas and ticks by killing them and stopping the spread of the parasites and of the diseases they transmit.

microcipare.name: Microchipping
microcipare.excerpt: A microchip is a small electronic device about the size of a grain of rice. The microchip is placed under your dog's or cat's skin, between the shoulder blades, with a quick injection…
microcipare.body:
A microchip is a small electronic device about the size of a grain of rice. The microchip is placed under your dog's or cat's skin, between the shoulder blades, with a quick injection. Once implanted, your dog or cat cannot feel the microchip, and the special capsule around it means it does not break down and is designed to last your pet's whole life.

The microchip is encoded with a unique number that can be read by a scanner. Microchips do not store personal data; your details are kept against the unique identification number in a secure database. If your dog or cat is found and taken to the nearest veterinary practice to be scanned by a vet, the microchip database is accessed online, and the organisation holding your dog, for example a veterinary practice, a rescue centre or the police, can use the number to find your details. You can then be contacted, and your pet can be safely returned to you.

testarea-progesteronului.name: Progesterone Testing
testarea-progesteronului.excerpt: A quantitative blood test for progesterone is the most accurate method for determining the ideal time for breeding. The result is reported as…
testarea-progesteronului.body:
A quantitative blood test for progesterone is the most accurate method for determining the ideal time for breeding. The result is reported as a number, usually in ng/dl.

At our clinic, we combine observation of the dog's and the bitch's behaviour with vaginal cytology, so that ovulation can be identified with great accuracy in most bitches.

An exact progesterone level is also needed when the bitch will travel a long distance for breeding, when fresh, chilled or frozen semen is to be used, or when dogs or bitches have a history of being difficult to breed. In addition, an exact progesterone level for timing ovulation is needed when a caesarean section is anticipated, or when the bitch is close to term and foetal viability needs to be assessed.

pasaport-calatorie.name: Pet Passport
pasaport-calatorie.excerpt: A European pet passport is a document that follows a standard EU format and is essential for travelling between EU countries. It contains a…
pasaport-calatorie.body:
A European pet passport is a document that follows a standard EU format and is essential for travelling between EU countries. It contains a description and details of your pet, including the microchip or tattoo code, as well as the rabies vaccination record and the contact details of the owner and of the vet who issued the passport.

You can get a European pet passport for your furry friends – your dog, cat or ferret – from our clinic.

The pet passport is valid for life as long as your pet's rabies vaccination is kept up to date.

citologie-vaginala.name: Vaginal Cytology
citologie-vaginala.excerpt: Vaginal cytology is a commonly performed assessment. The cells seen at the ideal time for breeding are a high percentage of cornified epithelial…
citologie-vaginala.body:
Vaginal cytology is a commonly performed assessment. The cells seen at the ideal time for breeding are a high percentage of cornified epithelial cells, with few red blood cells (RBCs), white blood cells (WBCs) or debris.

A vaginal smear can also indicate other problems, such as vaginitis. The test is simple, safe, inexpensive, well tolerated by a bitch approaching oestrus and very useful in timing breedings.

Examining a single smear can provide useful information, but it can also be misleading. For example, it is often difficult to tell pro-oestrus from dioestrus on a single smear.

At our clinic, we recommend carrying out other tests as well, such as progesterone testing, and assessing several smears taken from the same bitch to follow her progress, so that the optimal time for breeding can be determined accurately.

inseminare-artificiala.name: Artificial Insemination
inseminare-artificiala.excerpt: Natural mating can be an anxious experience for a bitch. At our clinic, our canine insemination services are designed to…
inseminare-artificiala.body:
Natural mating can be an anxious experience for a bitch.

At our clinic, our canine insemination services are designed to make things as relaxed and stress-free as possible for both the dogs and the owner. If transporting your bitch is a problem, we also offer artificial insemination at home. Artificial insemination can be carried out in the comfort of your own home or premises, where your bitch is likely to be most relaxed. This is often the best possible route to successful breeding.

Artificial insemination in dogs is not only a quick and highly successful breeding option, it is also the best way to protect your bitch's sexual health, as it makes it possible to breed with a 100% chance of not contracting sexually transmitted diseases.

serviciu-de-ambulanta.name: Ambulance Service
serviciu-de-ambulanta.excerpt: We understand that sinking feeling you get when your pet is ill – as vets, we have seen almost everything.…
serviciu-de-ambulanta.body:
We understand that sinking feeling you get when your pet is ill – as vets, we have seen almost everything. We also understand pet behaviour, so we know how to move your pet professionally without causing further injury, and how to keep them safe and comfortable on the way to the veterinary clinic.

When we arrive at your location, we assess your furry friend's condition – checking their breathing, any paleness, open wounds and other vital signs. We stay calm so that your pet can stay calm while they are carefully loaded into our secure cage with a safety system, using a lead, a transport carrier or a stretcher.

If needed, oxygen and fluids can be given during transport.

In an emergency, our staff will be ready to assist you and receive your pet as soon as we arrive. We promise to keep in clear contact with you throughout the journey
by phone and/or text message.

We can also transport your pet safely back home! Afterwards, we get busy cleaning with medical-grade disinfectants for our next patient who needs medical transport. This way, there is no risk of passing on any infectious disease through blood, faeces, coughing or sneezing, or other secretions.
